title: CPSC, First & Main Inc. Announce Recall of Plush Toys
summary: The decorative gem stones on the toy's wings could detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 2,300.

title: CPSC, Schylling Associates Inc. Announce Recall of More "Jack-In-the-Box" Type Toys
summary: The bead on the crank of the toy can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 14,000.

title: CPSC, Wal-Mart Announce Recall of Candles Because of Flammable Paint
summary: Paint on the exterior surface of the candles could potentially sustain flame, posing a potential fire hazard. Units: 69,804 units of the Snow House Candle gift set; 29,064 units of the Snowman Candle gift set; and 62,428 units of the Snowflake Candle gift set.

title: CPSC, Zutopia (a division of Wet Seal Inc.) Announce Recall of Girl's Loungewear
summary: The loungewear failed to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear posing a risk of serious burn injuries to children. The standard requires sleepwear, including loungewear, to be flame resistant and if the garment ignites, the flame must self-extinguish. Units: 5,500.

title: CPSC, S.K. Enterprises Announce Recall of Pressure Washers
summary: Overheating, posing a potential for fire and personal injury. Units: 38,000.

title: CPSC, Specialized Announce Recall of Brake Rotors On Mountain Bikes
summary: During heavy braking, the brake tabs on the front forks could break off, possibly causing a loss of control and fall from the bicycle. Units: 250.

title: CPSC, Coldwater Creek and Cape Craftsman Announce Recalls of Candleholders
summary: Flames from the tealight candle can ignite the candleholder, posing a fire and burn hazard. Units: 800.

title: CPSC, Firms Announce Recall of Infinity and Lifestyle Spas
summary: The motor capacitor, which is a component of the circulating pump, can overheat. This poses a fire hazard. Units: 13,000.

title: CPSC, Home Interiors & Gifts, Inc. Announce Recall of Snow Play Candleholder
summary: Flames from the votive candle can set fire to the rope linking three "sledding" snowmen. Units: 14,338.

title: CPSC, Club Car Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Hunting Vehicles
summary: The steering connections on the front suspension rack can come loose, posing a risk of the operator losing control of the vehicle. Units: 158.

summary: The operator can come in contact with the rotating blade, even when disengaged, by pulling on the front of the mower deck while the engine is running, posing a serious injury hazard to consumers. Units: 63,600.

title: CPSC, SCI Promotion Group LLC and Scripto-Tokai Corp. Announce Recall of Mini-Flashlights
summary: The mini-flashlight's battery compartment can overheat, presenting a possible burn hazard to consumers. Units: 448,000.

summary: Paint on the exterior surface of the candles could potentially sustain flame posing a potential fire hazard. Units: 10,085 units of the "Painted Snowman" gift set.

title: CPSC, Family Dollar Services Inc. Announce Recall of Extension Cords
summary: Use of these extension cords could result in an electric shock or electrocution to consumers. Units: 60,000.

title: CPSC, Crate and Barrel Announce Recall of Hanukkah Menorah
summary: The acrylic base of the Hanukkah menorah can ignite if the candles are allowed to burn completely, creating a fire hazard. Units: 800.

title: CPSC, Guth Lighting Announce Recall of Lighting Fixtures
summary: The lamp can fall out of the lamp socket and strike somebody standing or walking beneath the light fixture, posing a laceration risk if the lamp breaks. Units: 1,850.

title: CPSC, Emerson Tool Company Announce Recall of Wet/Dry Vacuums
summary: The exhaust blower ports on the wet/dry vacuums are large enough for a small child to reach inside and touch the spinning blower wheel. This poses a laceration hazard to small children. Units: .

title: CPSC, Hill-Rom Announce Recall of Rocking Chairs
summary: The chairs' support assembly can fail and cause the rocking chair to collapse, posing the risk of injury to the user. Units: 2,900.

title: CPSC, Mr. Christmas Inc. Announce Recall of Christmas Candleholders
summary: The candleholders do not allow for the safe burning of a candle, which poses a fire hazard to consumers. Units: 2,300.

title: CPSC, Avon Products Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Jack-In-the-Box Toys
summary: A spring mechanism attached to the lid can break and detach from the toy, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 56,000.
